items.markdown:
You can start building and managing structured data right away using the [Sanity Official Website](https://www.sanity.io/) to power your next web or mobile project.[[1]](https://www.sanity.io/)[[2]](https://jamstack.org/headless-cms/sanity/)

### What is Sanity CMS?

- **Headless Architecture:** Separates the backend content storage (the "body") from the frontend presentation layer (the "head").[[1]](https://www.sanity.io/headless-cms)
- **Structured Content:** Treats content as discrete JSON data objects instead of rigid HTML pages, making it fully reusable across websites, apps, and AI agents.[[1]](https://www.sanity.io/hotels-cms)[[2]](https://www.sanity.io/headless-cms)
- **Bring Your Own Frontend:** Compatible with modern frameworks like React, Next.js, Vue, SvelteKit, and Nuxt.[[1]](https://www.sanity.io/cms-use-cases)

### Core Components

- **Sanity Studio:** An open-source, customizable content workspace built with React and TypeScript where editors collaborate in real time.[[1]](https://www.sanity.io/studio)[[2]](https://jamstack.org/headless-cms/sanity/)
- **Content Lake:** A cloud-hosted, real-time database that stores structured documents and delivers assets securely over a global CDN.[[1]](https://jamstack.org/headless-cms/sanity/)[[2]](https://dev.to/maniekm/best-use-cases-of-sanity-cms-features-pricing-implementation-guide-hmi)
- **GROQ & APIs:** Uses GROQ (Graph-Relational Object Queries) alongside GraphQL-like flexibility to fetch data efficiently.[[1]](https://dev.to/maniekm/best-use-cases-of-sanity-cms-features-pricing-implementation-guide-hmi)

If you'd like to dive deeper, let me know:

- What **frontend framework** are you planning to use?
- Are you migrating from an **existing CMS** like WordPress?

I can provide a quick setup guide or schema example for your project.
